summary: First iteration full E2E test for Délices Mikaté Royal vitrine. All backend endpoints and core frontend flows verified successfully.

issues: The link 'Commander' and the right CTA button 'Commander' have identical labels which can confuse users — consider renaming the CTA to e.g. 'Commander maintenant'.

action_items: Optional: rename the navbar CTA button to differentiate it from the 'Commander' nav link.
Replace RESEND_API_KEY placeholder with a real key when ready (currently emails are not sent; behaviour matches spec).
critical_code_review_comments: logger is defined AFTER it is referenced inside create_order's except block (line 228 uses logger but logging.basicConfig + getLogger are below at lines 257-261). If Resend ever raises, this would raise NameError. Move logger setup above the routes.
OrderForm.jsx useEffect resets preselected via onConsume() but addProduct increments quantity, so clicking 'Commander' on the same product card twice in a row correctly stacks — verified working.
Frontend api.js does not handle a missing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — minor, would only break in dev.
Order email_block / msg_block embed user input directly into HTML (no escaping). Low risk now (admin-only email), but consider escaping for XSS hardening.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test order via API + 1 via UI ('TEST_Aminata', 'TEST UI Client'). Both persisted in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 6 products, 3 testimonials served from static lists. Orders persisted in Mongo collection 'orders' (no _id leak). email_sent=false intended while RESEND_API_KEY is placeholder. Frontend uses data-testid from /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds.js. Toast library: sonner. Smooth scroll IDs: #accueil, #produits, #galerie, #temoignages, #commander.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues blocking the MVP. Tests cover: GET /api/, /api/products (6 items + expected names), /api/testimonials (3 items), POST /api/orders (success, empty body 422, empty items 422), GET /api/orders (created order appears first, no _id). Frontend: page load, hero CTAs, 6 product cards, 6 gallery items, WhatsApp float href, Facebook+Instagram footer links, clicking product 'Commander' adds item + scrolls to #commander, full form submission shows success toast 'Commande enregistrée ! Nous vous contactons par téléphone.', testimonials section contains all 3 names (Aminata, Koffi, Sarah), navbar 'Catalogue' link smooth-scrolls to products.
